cases.name: accepted_batch
cases.meaning: every event of the one-event batch is held; accepted_events + duplicate_events + len(rejected_events) equals the events sent -- delivered, do not send it again

cases.name: duplicate_batch
cases.meaning: every event of the one-event batch is held; accepted_events + duplicate_events + len(rejected_events) equals the events sent -- delivered, do not send it again

cases.name: sensor_status_accepted_snapshot
cases.meaning: the snapshot is held as this device's sensor state; accepted_sensors + len(rejected_sensors) equals the sensors sent -- a rejected entry is counted, logged and not retried, and the next snapshot supersedes it

cases.name: sensor_status_partial_snapshot
cases.meaning: the snapshot is held as this device's sensor state; accepted_sensors + len(rejected_sensors) equals the sensors sent -- a rejected entry is counted, logged and not retried, and the next snapshot supersedes it
